mechanism: Dexamethasone suppresses melatonin synthesis and circadian rhythm regulation through glucocorticoid-mediated inhibition of pineal gland function, while melatonin may counteract corticosteroid-induced immunosuppression.
action: Monitor sleep quality and circadian function; consider timing melatonin dosing away from dexamethasone administration; use melatonin cautiously as it may reduce dexamethasone's anti-inflammatory efficacy.
